clue.text: Do well, taking fee back from 35

indicators.note: taking one thing from another removes those letters from it

parts.note: the number 35 read out digit by digit is three five

indicators.note: back means the word fee is read from its end to its start

explanation.surface: Someone prospering by charging a fee out of a sum of thirty-five.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns FEE into EEF; 'taking' removes those letters, in order, from THREE FIVE, the digits of 35 spelt out.
explanation.definitionFit: To flourish or prosper is to do well.

clue.text: Exhaust my energy crossing river in rowing boat

indicators.note: crossing means straddling, so the other piece sits within

parts.note: exhaust my energy means wear me out, tire me
R is the map abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: A tired rower complains that crossing the river wears them out.
explanation.definitionFit: It was an ancient warship propelled by three banks of oars.

clue.text: … under way, disposing of old bones

indicators.note: in a down clue, under puts the first piece below the second
disposing of means discarding a letter

parts.note: a road is a way
the ellipsis stands for this clue's number, 2, which in this puzzle is printed in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Getting rid of old bones while on the move.
explanation.walkthrough: The '…' is the clue number II; 'disposing of' drops O from ROAD, leaving RAD, and 'under' sets II below it.
explanation.definitionFit: These are forearm bones, the plural of the Latin-named radius.

clue.text: Win against one Conservative after another

indicators.note: after places the next piece behind

parts.note: V is short for versus, against
I is the Roman numeral one
another Conservative is a Tory

explanation.surface: An election win as one Conservative follows another.
explanation.walkthrough: TORY is a British name for a member of the Conservative Party.
explanation.definitionFit: A triumph or success is synonymous with a win.

clue.text: … interrupting calls from Spain providing source of oil

indicators.note: interrupting means breaking into the middle of the other piece

parts.note: olé is the Spanish cry of approval, so calls are oles
the ellipsis stands for this clue's number, 4, which in this puzzle is printed in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Something breaking into Spanish shouts and turning out to be where oil comes from.
explanation.walkthrough: In the paper each clue number was printed in Roman numerals; a clue opening with '…' carries on from its own number, so the numeral is part of the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Olive oil is pressed from the fruit, so the fruit is a source of the oil.

clue.text: … dividing 50 euro mislaid in museum

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty

indicators.note: dividing means splitting the other piece by sitting inside
mislaid suggests the letters are put in the wrong places

parts.note: the ellipsis stands for this clue's number, 5, which in this puzzle is printed in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Splitting fifty euros lost while visiting a museum.
explanation.walkthrough: The '…' is V; 'mislaid' turns EURO into OURE, and 'dividing' puts V inside it after L.
explanation.definitionFit: The Paris gallery holding the Mona Lisa is the world's most visited museum.

clue.text: … being dishonest about condition — that's insulting

parts.note: the ellipsis stands for this clue's number, 6, which in this puzzle is printed in Roman numerals

indicators.note: about means wrapped around the other piece

parts.note: being dishonest is telling untruths, lying
if introduces a condition

explanation.surface: Accusing someone of dishonesty about their condition is a slur.
explanation.walkthrough: The '…' is the clue number VI, which leads the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Defaming or abusing someone verbally is a way of insulting them.

clue.text: For daytime viewers, alternative to watch

definitions.text: For daytime viewers, alternative to watch

parts.words: For daytime viewers, alternative to watch
parts.note: a timepiece readable only when the sun shines, an alternative to a wristwatch

explanation.surface: Television advice suggesting what daytime viewers could watch instead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'viewers' and 'watch' suggest television; the watch is a timepiece.
explanation.definitionFit: It tells the time from a shadow cast by the sun, so only by day.

clue.text: Starting with 16 down, they're found in 9 and on 7

definitions.text: Starting with 16 down, they're found in 9 and on 7

parts.words: Starting with 16 down, they're found in 9 and on 7
parts.note: the series begins with the letter for one, spells 9 across, and marks the hours on 7 down's dial

explanation.walkthrough: 16 down reads 'I for one': these figures begin with I standing for 1. Every 9 across letter is one of them, and sundials often bear them.
explanation.definitionFit: Letters such as I, V, X, L, C, D and M were the ancient Latin way of writing figures.

clue.text: Calm resulting from savage having leader overthrown

indicators.note: the leading letter is overturned, turned upside down, so its shape becomes a different letter

parts.note: savage and wild are synonyms, as of an untamed beast

explanation.surface: A fierce mob becomes peaceful once its ringleader is toppled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having leader overthrown' turns the W of WILD upside down, where it looks like M.
explanation.definitionFit: Mild and calm are both said of gentle weather or a placid temperament.

clue.text: Dancers on stage refrain, in part

definitions.meaning: a troupe of backing dancers in a musical show
a single line of a song's recurring chorus

explanation.surface: Stage dancers singing part of a repeated tune.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names both a row of show dancers and one line of a chorus.

clue.text: … between two states, a state that borders Texas

indicators.note: between puts one piece in the middle of the other

parts.note: ME is Maine and CO is Colorado, two US state abbreviations
the ellipsis stands for this clue's number, 11, which in this puzzle is printed in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Something lying between two American states, next to Texas.
explanation.walkthrough: The '…' reads on from the clue number, printed in Roman numerals; ME is Maine and CO Colorado.
explanation.definitionFit: The country is a sovereign nation, a state in that sense, sharing a long border with Texas.

clue.text: ie a floor redesigned for wing, say

indicators.note: redesigned says the letters are laid out in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A floor is redesigned to work as an aircraft wing.
explanation.definitionFit: A wing is one example of a shaped surface giving lift, hence 'say'.

clue.text: Unintentionally revealing carrier, in essence

indicators.note: in places one piece within the other

parts.note: one's being is one's essential nature
a tray carries things

explanation.surface: A carrier unwittingly giving away what it holds inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A face that gives away hidden feelings is said to show or disclose them involuntarily.

clue.text: … gripped by broken feeler, turned back on itself

indicators.note: gripped by means held inside the other piece
broken says the letters are smashed and reassembled

parts.note: the ellipsis stands for this clue's number, 14, which in this puzzle is printed in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Something caught by a damaged antenna and folded back on itself.
explanation.walkthrough: The '…' reads on from the clue number in Roman numerals; 'broken' makes REFLEE of the feeler's letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A grammatical or mathematical relation that refers back to its own subject is described this way.

clue.text: Plant 9, first reduced by 50%, finally by 90%

indicators.note: the last letter, a Roman five hundred, is cut by ninety per cent to the numeral for fifty
the first letter, a Roman thousand, is halved to the numeral for five hundred

parts.note: the answer to 9 across, made entirely of Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A plant whose numbers drop by half at first and nine tenths at last.
explanation.walkthrough: Read MILD as Roman numerals: M (1000) halved is D (500), giving DILD; the final D (500) less 90% is L (50).
explanation.definitionFit: The herb with feathery leaves used with fish is a garden plant.

clue.text: Sign of don intermittently showing intelligence

indicators.note: intermittently means only every other letter is taken

explanation.surface: A sign that a university don shows flashes of brainpower now and then.
explanation.definitionFit: Intelligence in the sense of news or data is information.

clue.text: Brendan at least provided more money, apart from tips

parts.note: provided means on condition that, if

indicators.note: apart from tips means each word loses its first and last letters

explanation.surface: The setter, at least, provided more cash, tips excepted.
explanation.walkthrough: Brendan is this puzzle's setter, so he is an example of the speaker's 'I'.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means 'speaking personally', the setter offering himself as one example.

clue.text: Ace faces wild animals, not a good idea

parts.note: A is the card abbreviation for ace
mug is slang for face
game is wild animals hunted for sport

explanation.surface: An ace pilot confronting beasts, which is unwise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'faces' looks like a verb but supplies the noun MUGS.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes a pointless or foolish venture only a dupe would take up.

clue.text: Accursed Englishman's midday companion going up North

indicators.note: going up in a down clue means read from bottom to top

parts.note: Noel Coward's song says mad dogs and Englishmen go out in the midday sun

explanation.surface: A cursed English traveller's lunchtime friend heading north.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mad dogs and Englishmen' is a Noel Coward song about Britons braving the noon sun.
explanation.definitionFit: Damned and cursed are both used as an oath, so the word means accursed.

clue.text: … in line for joining up, Brazilian dances

indicators.note: in places one piece within the other
up in a down clue means read upward, back to front

parts.note: a seam is the line where two pieces of fabric are joined
the ellipsis stands for this clue's number, 19, which in this puzzle is printed in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Dancers lining up for Brazilian dances.
explanation.walkthrough: The '…' reads on from the clue number in Roman numerals; 'up' gives MAES.
explanation.definitionFit: The maxixe is a Brazilian couple dance related to the tango, here in the plural.

clue.text: Humbled since caught in a plot

indicators.note: caught in means held inside the other piece

parts.note: a bed is a garden plot
as can mean since, because

explanation.surface: Someone humiliated after being caught in a conspiracy.
explanation.definitionFit: To be brought low or degraded is to be humbled.

clue.text: Midpoint of Romeo and Juliet on radio

definitions.text: Midpoint of Romeo and Juliet on radio

parts.words: Midpoint of Romeo and Juliet on radio
parts.note: Romeo and Juliet are radio code words for R and J; the letter midway between them in the alphabet is N, whose code word is wanted

explanation.surface: The centre of a radio broadcast of Shakespeare's play.
explanation.walkthrough: R is the 18th letter, J the 10th; halfway is the 14th, N, spoken in the NATO alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the NATO phonetic code word for the letter N.

clue.text: High-class crew returned, having lost little time

indicators.note: having lost means a letter is dropped out
returned means the word is read back to front

parts.note: crew is a past tense of crow, which means exulted
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: A smart rowing crew came back having shaved a moment off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crew' is not a team but the verb, crowed; 'returned' gives DETLUXE, and 'having lost' removes T.
explanation.definitionFit: Luxurious or superior goods are described with this French phrase for top quality.

clue.text: Left duo holding check for fare from China

indicators.note: holding means the other piece sits inside

parts.note: II is the Roman numeral for two
CH is the chess abbreviation for check

explanation.surface: A pair leaving a check for their Chinese meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fare' is food, not a ticket price.
explanation.definitionFit: The fruit, also spelt lychee, is a Chinese food.

clue.text: Musical system that can be revised for solo, in fact

indicators.note: can be revised says the letters may be rearranged

explanation.surface: A music teaching method that really can be adapted for a soloist.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the doh-ray-me method of teaching sight-singing, a system of musical notation.

clue.text: One over eight, in front of a joint

indicators.note: in front of places the first piece before the second

parts.note: the cox sits in charge of a rowing eight

explanation.surface: Someone a drink too many, slumped before a joint of meat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One over eight' is a British idiom for slightly drunk; here it means the cox who commands an eight-oared crew.
explanation.definitionFit: Anatomically, the term is Latin for the hip, and names the hip joint or an insect's leg base.

clue.text: Tips about the writer making changes for the better

indicators.note: about means surrounding the other piece

parts.note: tips are ends, as of fingers
the writer refers to the setter, so me

explanation.surface: Advice from an author on improving their own work.
explanation.definitionFit: To correct or improve a text is to revise it, making it better.

clue.text: Points, one repeated, about sex and sins, in a way

indicators.note: about means wrapped around the other piece

parts.note: compass points east, north, east again, south
sex is Latin for six, which in Roman numerals is VI

explanation.surface: A sermon touching on sex and sins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sex' is the Latin word for six, so VI; Latin fits the Roman theme.
explanation.definitionFit: Envy is one of the seven deadly sins, so covetousness is one way of transgressing.
